title: Module 1: Personal Website
overview: Built a personal website with a Projects page using Flask, HTML, and CSS. This was the foundation for the semester's web development work.
learning: Learned the basics of Flask routing, templating, and serving static files.

title: Module 2: Python Foundations & Scraping
overview: Developed web scraping capabilities using BeautifulSoup and Selenium to collect GradCafe admissions data.
learning: Strengthened Python skills and learned to extract data from websites.

title: Module 3: SQL and Database Queries
overview: Designed and queried a PostgreSQL database for GradCafe admissions data.
learning: Learned to write complex SQL queries, joins, and aggregations.

title: Module 4: Testing and Documentation
overview: Added unit tests with Pytest and documentation with Sphinx.
learning: Understood the importance of test coverage and professional documentation.

title: Module 5: Flask Web Application
overview: Built a Flask web app with database integration and analysis pages.
learning: Integrated SQL with Flask to create dynamic web pages.

title: Module 6: Microservices with Docker & RabbitMQ
overview: Deployed a multi-service application with Flask, PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, and a worker.

title: Module 7: AWS S3, SageMaker, and EC2
overview: Built a cloud pipeline with S3, SageMaker, and deployed to EC2.
learning: Gained hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud deployment.

title: Module 8: Data Cleaning and EDA
overview: Cleaned, validated, and analyzed GradCafe data using Pandas and SciPy.
learning: Developed data cleaning workflows and exploratory analysis skills.

title: Module 9: K-Means Clustering
overview: Applied K-Means clustering to group similar program names using scikit-learn.
learning: Learned unsupervised learning and clustering evaluation.

title: Module 10: Data Dashboard
overview: Built an interactive dashboard with Dash and Plotly.
learning: Created interactive visualizations and learned dashboard design.

title: Module 11: MLOps Tracking
overview: Tracked K-Means experiments with MLflow and wandb.
learning: Learned experiment tracking and model registry concepts.

title: Module 12: Neural Network from Scratch
overview: Implemented a two-layer neural network using NumPy only.
learning: Deepened understanding of backpropagation and gradient descent.

title: Module 13: Multimodal Admissions Prediction
overview: Fine-tuned a DistilBERT model on GradCafe data and deployed it in a Flask app.
learning: Learned PyTorch, Hugging Face, and full-stack ML deployment.
